class Student:
    def __init__(self, aNumber, *allMentors):
        self._number = aNumber
        self._mentors = []
        self._courses = []
        if not self.setMentors(*allMentors):
            raise RuntimeError("Unable to create Student, must have at least 1 mentors. See https://manual.umple.org?RE002ViolationofAssociationMultiplicity.html")

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getMentor(self, index):
        return self._mentors[index]

    def getMentors(self):
        return tuple(self._mentors)

    def numberOfMentors(self):
        return len(self._mentors)

    def hasMentors(self):
        return len(self._mentors) > 0

    def indexOfMentor(self, aMentor):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)

    def getCourse(self, index):
        return self._courses[index]

    def getCourses(self):
        return tuple(self._courses)

    def numberOfCourses(self):
        return len(self._courses)

    def hasCourses(self):
        return len(self._courses) > 0

    def indexOfCourse(self, aCourse):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._courses) if x is aCourse), -1)

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfMentors():
        return 1

    def addMentor(self, aMentor):
        if any(x is aMentor for x in self._mentors):
            return False
        existingStudent = aMentor.getStudent()
        if existingStudent is not None and existingStudent.numberOfMentors() <= self.minimumNumberOfMentors():
            return False
        if existingStudent is not None:
            index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(existingStudent._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)
            if index >= 0:
                del existingStudent._mentors[index]
        self._mentors.append(aMentor)
        aMentor._student = self
        return True

    def removeMentor(self, aMentor):
        index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)
        if index < 0 or self.numberOfMentors() <= self.minimumNumberOfMentors():
            return False
        del self._mentors[index]
        aMentor._student = None
        return True

    def setMentors(self, *newMentors):
        if len(newMentors) < self.minimumNumberOfMentors():
            return False
        checkNewMentors = set()
        studentToNewMentors = {}
        for aMentor in newMentors:
            if id(aMentor) in checkNewMentors:
                return False
            existingStudent = aMentor.getStudent()
            if existingStudent is not None and existingStudent is not self:
                nextCount = studentToNewMentors.get(id(existingStudent), existingStudent.numberOfMentors()) - 1
                if nextCount < 1:
                    return False
                studentToNewMentors[id(existingStudent)] = nextCount
            checkNewMentors.add(id(aMentor))
        for orphan in self._mentors:
            if id(orphan) not in checkNewMentors:
                orphan._student = None
        self._mentors.clear()
        for aMentor in newMentors:
            existingStudent = aMentor.getStudent()
            if existingStudent is not None:
                index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(existingStudent._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)
                if index >= 0:
                    del existingStudent._mentors[index]
            aMentor._student = self
            self._mentors.append(aMentor)
        return True

    def addMentorAt(self, aMentor, index):
        if not self.addMentor(aMentor):
            return False
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfMentors():
            index = self.numberOfMentors() - 1
        del self._mentors[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)]
        self._mentors.insert(index, aMentor)
        return True

    def addOrMoveMentorAt(self, aMentor, index):
        if not any(x is aMentor for x in self._mentors):
            return self.addMentorAt(aMentor, index)
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfMentors():
            index = self.numberOfMentors() - 1
        del self._mentors[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._mentors) if x is aMentor), -1)]
        self._mentors.insert(index, aMentor)
        return True

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfCourses():
        return 0

    def addCourse(self, aCourse):
        if any(x is aCourse for x in self._courses):
            return False
        self._courses.append(aCourse)
        if aCourse.indexOfStudent(self) == -1 and not aCourse.addStudent(self):
            del self._courses[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._courses) if x is aCourse), -1)]
            return False
        return True

    def removeCourse(self, aCourse):
        oldIndex = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._courses) if x is aCourse), -1)
        if oldIndex == -1:
            return False
        del self._courses[oldIndex]
        if aCourse.indexOfStudent(self) != -1 and not aCourse.removeStudent(self):
            self._courses.insert(oldIndex, aCourse)
            return False
        return True

    def addCourseAt(self, aCourse, index):
        if not self.addCourse(aCourse):
            return False
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfCourses():
            index = self.numberOfCourses() - 1
        del self._courses[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._courses) if x is aCourse), -1)]
        self._courses.insert(index, aCourse)
        return True

    def addOrMoveCourseAt(self, aCourse, index):
        if not any(x is aCourse for x in self._courses):
            return self.addCourseAt(aCourse, index)
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfCourses():
            index = self.numberOfCourses() - 1
        del self._courses[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._courses) if x is aCourse), -1)]
        self._courses.insert(index, aCourse)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        for aMentor in self._mentors:
            aMentor._student = None
        self._mentors.clear()
        copyOfCourses = tuple(self._courses)
        self._courses.clear()
        for aCourse in copyOfCourses:
            aCourse.removeStudent(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
                + "]")
